text: Recently at Parks and Environment Committee there was presentation on Tree Protection through the Committee of Adjustment process which laid out how applications to remove trees are dealt with at Urban Forestry and the Committee of Adjustment. I believe it would be helpful for our Community Council to get the following information on Committee of Adjustment decisions affecting trees.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Requested the Director, Community Planning, Toronto and East York, and the Director, Urban Forestry to report back to the Toronto and East York Community Council on the number of Committee of Adjustment applications heard at the Committee of Adjustment in 2015, 2016 and 2017 in Toronto and East York district and of those applications: a. the number of applications for which Urban Forestry wrote a refusal report for the removal of a private tree which was upheld by Committee of Adjustment; and b. the number of applications for which Urban Forestry wrote a refusal report on "consent to sever" applications which impacted a city tree and which was upheld by Committee of Adjustment.
